resources.string: Switches at the current musical position with a smooth crossfade.
Phase-locked crossfade (0.5s entering On the Water, 2.0s returning to Normal) in both Main and Final Lap.
Phase-locked 0.5s bidirectional crossfade between Normal and Inside the Screen in both Main and Final Lap.
Advance to the next lap at its authored boundary. Lap 5 leads to Final Lap.
